name: Vector Line (Highest Lowest HL20)
description: Dynamic support baseline using Highest(Lowest(low,20),20). Rising vector with price above = buyers in control.

rules.computation_bars: ALL bars (RTH + ETH) — never RTH-only for vector computation
rules.flat_ok: Flat slope (vector[now] == vector[3]) is acceptable. Declining is not.
rules.declining_60m_blocks_all: 60m vector declining -> skip ALL Long signals on any interval
rules.secondary_vectors: Any secondary interval (1m/5m/15m/60m) vector below price = +1 bonus
rules.no_tabletopped_entries: Flat/tabletopped vector with no retest = exhausted momentum, skip
rules.signal_fires_next_bar: Entry is on the NEXT bar after both gates are met, not the same bar
rules.minimum_timeframes: Only one timeframe needs to confirm. If only one, it must be the primary timeframe being traded.
rules.short_caution: Vector is not a strong confluence for shorts — always seek zone or footprint co-confirmation

shortNote: Not a strong confluence for shorts — seek additional confirmation

tabletopSlippageTolerance.note: Observed from real trade data. Candle may WICK through vector by this amount and still return to profit — do NOT exit on wick alone.

tabletopInitiationRate.note: % of trades where vector wicked through then returned to profit (initiation). Remaining % broke through and trended down.

confluenceImpact.note: From 30-min data: trades with BOTH 5min and 15min confluence had near-100% tabletop initiation. No confluence = loss rate approaches 100%.
